focus_areas: Legibility and structure of the embossed text
Geometric symmetry and mechanical plausibility of the spool hubs
Sharpness and realism of the plastic molding details
Clarity of the tape path between spools
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'text_gibberish' artifact. In real cassettes, embossed text is usually crisp and legible (e.g., brand names, type). AI often fails here. Also, scrutinize the spool hubs; they should be perfectly symmetrical star shapes. Any asymmetry or melting indicates generation failure. The lack of a paper label is acceptable for some cassettes, but the embossed text quality is the key discriminator here.
image_description: A close-up, front-facing view of a black audio cassette tape. The image shows the top half of the cassette body, including two white spools with star-shaped hubs visible through circular windows. There is embossed text on the plastic casing above the spools, which appears illegible or gibberish. The bottom edge of the frame cuts off just below the spool windows, showing part of the rectangular opening area and some molded structural details.
